nodes.description: Privileged owner address of HyperShibaInu; assigned msg.sender in the constructor and used as the sole access-control gate for init, batchSend, setTradeAddress, delegate and for the whitelist bypass in ensure.
Public mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances; mutated by transferFrom, batchSend and the constructor and read by transferFrom/ensure paths.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances; mutated by approve and transferFrom and pre-seeded to uint(-1) for the UNI router in the constructor.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting how many sales an address has performed; read by condition and incremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist checked in ensure to bypass the sale-limit condition.
Private minimum sale amount (scaled by decimals) set by init and enforced by condition.
Private maximum sale amount (scaled by decimals) set by init and enforced by condition.
Private maximum number of sales per address set by init and enforced by condition.
Address of a trusted trading contract written by setTradeAddress and used as a whitelist bypass in ensure.
Public total token supply set once in the constructor from the supplied amount.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address 0x7a25...88D; whitelisted in ensure and granted unlimited allowance in the constructor.
Public payable ERC20 transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).

Internal view guard invoked by transferFrom; recomputes the Uniswap pair via pairFor and bypasses the sale limits for owner, UNI router, pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise requiring condition().
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance deduction, ensure() check, balance updates and _onSaleNum increment, all with unchecked native arithmetic.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval.
Internal view applying the sale-count, minimum-sale and maximum-sale restrictions read from _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-gated function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to user-supplied address `a` with user-supplied calldata `b`, allowing full storage takeover.
Owner-gated initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum from the supplied saleNum/token/maxToken parameters.
Owner-gated mass transfer looping over _tos, computing total = _value * _tos.length and emitting two half-value Transfer events per recipient with unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-gated setter for the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.
Internal pure Uniswap-V2 style pair address derivation using keccak256 over the factory, sorted tokens and init code hash.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, the owner balance and an unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, spender, allowance owner and balance owner across the contract.
Arbitrary delegatecall in delegate(address,bytes) allowing the callee to modify this contract's storage.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom (no SafeMath).
Unchecked balance updates balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, overflow can bypass the balance check.
Unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop.

Amount parameter of transfer.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Target address parameter of the delegatecall in delegate.
Calldata bytes parameter of the delegatecall in delegate.
Maximum per-address sale count parameter of init.

Maximum sale amount parameter of init, scaled by 10**decimals.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend.
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend.
New trade address parameter of setTradeAddress.
Sender address parameter of ensure, checked against owner, UNI, pair and canSale.
Recipient address parameter of ensure, checked against owner.
Value parameter of ensure, forwarded to condition.
Address parameter of condition used to index _onSaleNum.
Amount parameter of condition compared with _minSale and _maxSale.
Local variable caching the computed Uniswap pair address inside ensure.
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Loop counter of batchSend.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting the caller unrestricted privileged control.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender index into allowance.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval for the caller.
transferFrom invokes ensure(_from, _to, _value) as its sale-limit gate.
ensure calls condition(_from, _value) when the address is not whitelisted.
ensure computes the Uniswap pair through pairFor before the whitelist checks.
ensure reads tradeAddress as a whitelist bypass condition.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass the sale-limit restriction.
ensure compares _from and _to against the owner address for privileged bypass.
condition reads _saleNum to decide whether per-address sale limits apply.
condition reads _minSale and rejects amounts below it.
condition reads _maxSale and rejects amounts above it.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the _saleNum limit.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
msg.sender indexes the allowance slot that is decremented without SafeMath.
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value.
transferFrom checks and mutates balanceOf for both parties.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer.
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall to address a with calldata b.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing the delegatecall.
delegate validates the caller against the owner state variable.
init writes _minSale derived from the token parameter and decimals.
init writes _maxSale derived from the maxToken parameter and decimals.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
init requires msg.sender == owner before mutating sale parameters.
init checks the caller against the owner state variable.
batchSend computes uint total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
batchSend performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the loop.
batchSend reads and decrements/increments balanceOf entries.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and uses balanceOf[msg.sender].
batchSend checks the caller against the owner state variable.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress checks the caller against the owner state variable.
Constructor sets totalSupply from _supply scaled by 10**decimals.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
Constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, defining the privileged role.
ensure references the UNI constant address when evaluating whitelist bypasses.
Constructor uses the UNI constant as the unlimited-allowance spender.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter has no independent security meaning outside transfer.
Amount parameter is only forwarded into transferFrom and carries no standalone node value.
Source parameter participates only in the transferFrom allowance/balance logic.
Recipient parameter is consumed solely inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter drives only the unchecked arithmetic of transferFrom.
Spender parameter is used only to key the allowance write in approve.
Allowance amount parameter exists only inside approve.
Target address parameter is only meaningful as the delegatecall target.
Calldata parameter is only meaningful as the delegatecall payload.
Sale-count parameter is stored by init alone.
Minimum-sale parameter is scaled and stored only by init.
Maximum-sale parameter is scaled and stored only by init.
Recipient array is iterated only by batchSend.
Per-recipient amount parameter feeds only the batchSend loop arithmetic.
New trade address parameter is written directly by setTradeAddress.
From-address parameter is used only in the ensure whitelist comparisons.
To-address parameter is used only in the ensure whitelist comparisons.
Value parameter is only forwarded from ensure into condition.
Address parameter indexes _onSaleNum only inside condition.
Amount parameter is compared with the sale bounds only inside condition.
Cached pair address local exists only as an intermediate inside ensure.
Local total is computed and consumed only by batchSend's balance check.
Loop counter has no meaning outside the batchSend iteration.
Loop-local recipient is only used for the per-iteration balance credit.
